posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
There's stories in the replies here of people traveling the world while receiving 2 years of free salary for being "burnt out "

It's amazing!

I know stories of people receiving social housing apartments paying €300/mo, illegally renting them out for €1500/mo to expats then making a €1200/mo profit

Then they added unemployment, which is FREE fully paid salary of 70% of their last salary, 10 years ago that'd go on for 3 years (now 2 years), so in their case that was about €3500/mo of his previous €5000/mo salary

Then they moved to the other side of the world to a cheap country so they could make it go longer

€1200/mo renting out social housing illegally
€3500/mo unemployment
+=
€4700/mo free money for 3+ years

If you wonder why Europeans don't like to work, it's because in Europe you don't actually need to work at all to make a lot of money
posts.text_zh:
回复里有人讲：挂着「burn out」领两年白拿工资，同时环游世界。

太离谱了！

我还听过：拿社宅，自己只交 €300/月，再违法转租给外派，租 €1500/月，净赚 €1200/月。

再加上失业金——按上份工资 70% 全额白拿；十年前能领三年（现在两年），以他为例大约是以前 €5000/月里的 €3500/月。

然后人搬到地球另一边的便宜国家，好把这笔钱拖更久。

€1200/月（违法转租社宅）
€3500/月（失业金）
合计
€4700/月白拿，持续 3 年多。

你要问欧洲人为什么不爱干活：在欧洲根本不用干活也能赚很多钱。
posts.quote_note: 引用自己上一帖：多数荷兰朋友「burn out」，可领一年全薪再一年七成薪在家躺平，还要在 Facetime 上装累，实际在家看 Netflix。

posts.author: levelsio
posts.quote_note: 引用他人吐槽荷兰雇佣法：试用期刚结束员工请一天病假就无法解约，期间还装修房子、不配合 UWV 材料，雇主可能要多付一年约 8 万欧；对约 350 万营收的公司压力很大，保险也贵，赛事后不想再雇人。

posts.author: marclou
posts.text:
It took me:

- 2 years to make $1 online
- 8 months to get 1,000 followers 
- 3 months to grow a SaaS to $1k MRR

I’ve built 43 startups and posted 38.7K tweets.

It takes time. 

Whoever pretends otherwise is trying to sell you a get-rich-quick dream.
posts.text_zh:
我花了：

- 2 年才在网上赚到 $1
- 8 个月才到 1,000 粉丝
- 3 个月才把一个 SaaS 做到 $1k MRR

我做了 43 个创业项目，发了 38.7K 条推文。

这需要时间。

谁跟你说不是这样，多半是在卖「快速暴富」的梦。
posts.quote_note: 引用 @gregisenberg：提醒创始人现在到处都是假 ARR 数字。

posts.author: steipete
posts.text: Another reason why you wanna use your own harness and not one where companies change what you can or can’t do at will.
posts.text_zh: 这又是一个理由：你该用自己的 harness（智能体运行框架），而不是用那种公司可以随时改规则、决定你能做什么不能做什么的东西。
posts.quote_note: 引用帖：有人爆料 Anthropic 约从 10 月 27 日起通过服务器下发一条名为 "tengu_heron_brook" 的规则，限制 Claude Code 去重写/复刻已有电子游戏（只鼓励做原创或同类型游戏），而且没有任何设置能关掉。

posts.author: steipete
posts.text:
Bullish on Andy Yen and Proton. He gets it.

The culture war, or rather the loss of identity some engineers feel as AI redefines our jobs is difficult; I sympathize. Also understand that he runs a business and might has limited patience when we now had two years to process, learn, change and grow.
posts.text_zh:
看多 Andy Yen 和 Proton。他懂这件事。

所谓文化战——更准确说，是部分工程师在 AI 重塑岗位时感到的身份失落——确实很难；我同情。也理解他在经营公司，而我们已经有两年时间去消化、学习、改变和成长，他可能没那么多耐心。
posts.quote_note: 引用他人放出的 Proton CTO AI 宣言截图/文稿。
